title: The Famous Glitch That Changed World of Warcraft

scenes.text: 2005's World of Warcraft had a game-breaking glitch
The 'Corrupted Blood' glitch spread rapidly, infecting thousands of players
The glitch was caused by a debuff that was meant to affect only one player

scenes.label: Game Design
scenes.text: The Corrupted Blood glitch led to changes in WoW's game design and testing
Follow for the future, one byte at a time.

description: In 2005, a game-breaking glitch spread rapidly in World of Warcraft, infecting thousands of players. Find out how the 'Corrupted Blood' glitch changed the game's design and testing. Follow us for more gaming history and glitches!
